title: Raise per-crate library coverage to 90%
description:
Every production crate should report at least 90% library line coverage. The current shortfall is driven mostly by CLI/campaign binaries and dev helpers counted in the denominator, not by under-tested library logic.

## Background

A fresh `cargo llvm-cov --workspace` run shows the headline per-crate numbers are dragged down by non-library code. Splitting uncovered lines by file type:

| Crate | Library-only | CLI binaries (`src/bin/`) | dev/test helpers |
|-------|:---:|:---:|:---:|
| gf2-coding | 91.1% | 30.1% (736 uncov) | — |
| gf2-kernels-simd | 92.8% | — | — |
| gf2-algebra | 89.6% | — | 33.3% (26 uncov) |
| gf2-core | 89.5% | — | 57.4% (294 uncov) |
| gf2-sim | 86.7% | 51.9% (734 uncov) | 83.3% |

Two levers close the gap: (1) measure coverage against library code only, excluding CLI `main()` entrypoints and dev/bench/test helpers; (2) add targeted tests for the genuinely under-covered library modules in gf2-core, gf2-algebra, and gf2-sim. After lever 1, gf2-coding and gf2-kernels-simd already clear the bar; the remaining real-test work is roughly 356 covered lines across three crates.

## Success Criteria

- [ ] `[hard]` REQ-1: Every production crate (gf2-core, gf2-coding, gf2-algebra, gf2-sim, gf2-kernels-simd) reports library line coverage at or above 90.0% on the CI badge run.
- [ ] `[hard]` REQ-2: Coverage measurement excludes non-library code (CLI binaries under `src/bin/`, plus dev/bench/test-support helpers), and the exclusion set is documented.
- [ ] `[hard]` REQ-3: README coverage badges display the at-or-above-90% per-crate numbers.

## Notes

`gfp/simd_ops.rs` (gf2-core) is SIMD-feature-gated and low-ROI to cover; it is not a required target. New tests must respect the fast-tier discipline in CLAUDE.md (per-test 5s budget; sim tests above the frame/query thresholds carry `#[ignore]`).
